profile_text.body:
Meta's developer site presents the company as a provider of AI models and tools for developers, offering access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The site describes Muse Spark as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and says it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It also describes a quick start that produces a first working request in under five minutes by pointing an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and a search grounding tool that gives a model live access to the web. Muse Image is offered on the Meta Model API at $0.01/image, described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, with anchored composition for consistent edits.

The product tracked for Meta is Llama, an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. Meta is a public company, ticker META, CIK 0001326801, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA. Its most recent reported revenue is $200,966,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, filed on form 10-K.

Litigation involving the company includes Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. California is recorded as the state with the highest law exposure count, at 281. MCP servers listed for Meta Ads automation include ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, with 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights; co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp, for analyzing performance, testing creatives, and optimizing spend; and com.adbloop/meta-ads, for bulk-creating Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders.
